findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cnpj, dossier_cnpj, contact · Private data: contact, add_watch, api_access, api_access_buy · Public sink: get_cnpj, avaliar, ia_filters, contact, api_access_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cnpj, dossier_cnpj, contact · Private data: contact, add_watch, api_access, api_access_buy · Public sink: get_cnpj, avaliar, ia_filters, contact, api_access_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
